description: Likely US product compliance rules for a product sold into a US state or market: CPSIA children's product certificate vs general certificate, California Prop 65 warnings, Minnesota PFAS (Amara's Law), and state packaging EPR (Oregon, Colorado, California). Each item is a potential issue with an official source link and the ALK desk that fixes it. Read-only, not legal advice.

contains_intentionally_added_pfas.description: Known or suspected intentionally added PFAS

for_children_12_or_under.description: Designed or intended primarily for children 12 or younger

imported.description: You import the product into the US

product_type.description: What the product is, e.g. 'kids toy', 'water bottle', 'rain jacket'

sold_in_packaging.description: Ships in packaging or paper you supply (default true)

state.description: US state (2-letter code or name) or 'US' for nationwide
